issues.description: Mismatch between the UML/spec and the provided code for Stock.add(String): the problem statement UML declares `Stock.add(String): void`, but both template and solution implement `public int add(String ingredient)`. Students following the UML will implement the wrong method signature and fail compilation/tests expecting the starter-code signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the UML/spec match the starter code by changing the diagram entry to `add(String): int` and briefly document what the return value represents (e.g., new quantity or -1 on failure). Alternatively, if `void` was intended, change both template and solution to `void add(String)` and update all call sites accordingly.

issues.description: The problem statement says to "add getters for all the private fields", but the provided template already exposes a public setter `Stock.setStockIngredients(...)`. This conflicts with the stated encapsulation guidance and can confuse students about whether setters are allowed/required.
issues.suggestedFix: Clarify the statement to "add getters for all private fields (some setters may already exist)" or remove `setStockIngredients(...)` from the template if strict getter-only encapsulation is intended.
